claims.claim: Every A9 packing can be normalized into an 1188×839 subrectangle of A0.
claims.evidence: For fixed labels and orientations, the feasible coordinate set is compact: containment bounds it, and each pairwise nonoverlap condition is a finite union of closed inequalities. A minimizer of the sum of all x- and y-coordinates is simultaneously left- and top-stable. Any rectangle away from the left boundary must touch a left blocker with vertically overlapping interior; following blockers strictly decreases x and terminates at x=0. Thus every right edge is a nonnegative integer combination of 52 and 37. The analogous argument applies to bottom edges. Exact enumeration shows that the largest such combination at most 1189 is 1188, while the largest at most 841 is 839. Hence the stable representative lies in [0,1188]×[0,839].
claims.witness: Semigroup certificates: 1188=20·52+4·37, while 1189 is not representable; 839=14·52+3·37, while 840 and 841 are not representable.
claims.search_method: Deductive compactness and blocker-chain proof, followed by exhaustive integer enumeration of all nonnegative combinations of 52 and 37 up to the two container dimensions.

claims.claim: There is an explicit packing of 516 sheets.
claims.evidence: The three stated grids generate exactly 60, 8, and 448 distinct rectangles. Exact checks confirm every rectangle has dimensions 52×37 or 37×52, all coordinates lie within 1188×839, and none of the 132870 unordered rectangle pairs has overlapping interior. Therefore they form a valid 516-sheet packing, also valid in the original A0 container.
claims.search_method: Regenerated all 516 rectangles with integer arithmetic and exhaustively checked cardinality, uniqueness, dimensions, containment, and every pair for strict interior overlap.

claims.claim: No packing has 518 sheets; hence OPT≤517.
claims.evidence: Claim 0 permits restriction to integer placements in 1188×839. Under the marker rule x+y≡50 mod 52, every 52×37 rectangle has one marked cell in each of 37 rows, and every 37×52 rectangle has one in each of 37 columns, so each has weight 1 after scaling marked cells by 1/37. Exhaustion of all 52² starting residues confirms this. The container has exactly 19162 marked cells: 52·22·16+44·16+7·22, with no 44×7 corner contribution because its residue sums range only from 0 through 49. Its total weight is 19162/37=517+33/37<518. Disjoint integer-aligned sheets cover disjoint unit cells, so an integral packing cardinality is at most 517.
claims.witness: Exact dual certificate w(x,y)=1/37 when x+y≡50 (mod 52), and w(x,y)=0 otherwise, on the 1188×839 integer-cell grid.
claims.search_method: Exhaustively checked both orientations for all 2704 possible starting residue pairs and directly counted every marked container cell using exact integers and rational arithmetic.

claims.claim: Any hypothetical 517-packing must span a maximum reduced dimension and contain a prescribed blocking chain.
claims.evidence: In the simultaneous stable representative from Claim 0, the occupied width and height are integers bounded by 1188 and 839. The 517 sheets have area 517·52·37=994708, whereas 1187·838=994706. Thus the bounding dimensions cannot both be at most 1187 and 838; the packing reaches x=1188 or y=839. A blocker chain to the corresponding origin boundary then has widths or heights summing to that extremal coordinate. Exact Diophantine enumeration gives the unique representations 1188=20·52+4·37 and 839=14·52+3·37, establishing the stated conditional chain compositions.
claims.witness: Extremal-chain certificates: a width-1188 chain has exactly twenty 52-width and four 37-width sheets; a height-839 chain has exactly fourteen 52-height and three 37-height sheets.
claims.search_method: Exact area comparison, blocker-chain deduction, and exhaustive enumeration of all nonnegative solutions to 52p+37q=1188 and 52p+37q=839.

claims.claim: The natural horizontal 111+728 decomposition is exactly capped at 516.
claims.evidence: The 1188×111 band's area permits at most 68 sheets, and the first two explicit grids attain 68. For the 1188×728 band, 37p+52q≤728 implies 37(5p+7q)=5(37p+52q)−q≤3640, hence 5p+7q≤98. Similarly, 52p+37q≤1188 implies 37(7p+5q)=5(52p+37q)−p≤5940, hence 7p+5q≤160. Integrating these inequalities over vertical and horizontal cross-sections gives 259N+n≤116424 and 260N−n≤116480. Therefore 519N≤232904<519·449, so N≤448. The stated 32×14 bottom grid attains 448. Thus packings respecting this split have exact maximum 68+448=516; the draft correctly disclaims any restriction on sheets crossing the split.
claims.witness: An attaining split packing consists of the 60+8 top-band rectangles and the 448 rectangles (37i,111+52j;37,52), 0≤i<32 and 0≤j<14.
claims.search_method: Deductive cross-section integration, exhaustive enumeration of all 156 feasible vertical and 396 feasible horizontal count pairs, and exact verification of the attaining grids.
